His two-year-old son died at the hospital from the injury he sustained in his grandparents' bedroom. While driving the child to the hospital, Aaron crashed the vehicle a few blocks from the house. By the time officers pieced the evening together, doctors at the hospital had not been able to save him. Cases like this one are rarely about the trigger. They're about everything that happened before it, a father already on probation, a grandmother being choked by her own husband inside the same room where a gun was drawn. A household that, long before any of it reached the front lawn, was already a place a small child was never going to be safe.
